jobs.description:
KAN DU STADIG SMILE KL. 05.30? [English Below]

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler bag baren på The Moose.

The Moose er ikke bare en bar. Det er et af Københavns mest ikoniske værtshuse – et sted, hvor stamgæster, turister, bartendere efter fyraften og københavnere, der absolut ikke er færdige med festen, mødes under samme tag.

Her er der højt tempo, kolde øl, lange nætter og masser af historier, som nok har bedst af at blive på The Moose.

Lige nu giver vi baren et friskt pust, og derfor leder vi efter nye bartendere, der har lyst til at blive en del af holdet.

Du behøver ikke kunne jonglere med flasker eller have fem års bartendererfaring. Vi lærer dig det, du skal kunne.

For os er det vigtigere, at du møder ind med god energi, kan tale med alle slags mennesker og har lyst til at skabe den stemning, der gør, at gæsterne bliver hængende lidt længere end planlagt.

VI LEDER EFTER DIG, DER...

• 
Er fyldt 18 år

• 
Møder på arbejde med godt humør og masser af energi

• 
Kan snakke med både stamgæsten i hjørnet og turistgruppen på deres første aften i København

• 
Trives, når baren er fyldt, musikken spiller, og tempoet er højt

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der pludselig står 15 mennesker og vil bestille på samme tid

• 
Er klar på nattevagter – også dem, der slutter, når resten af København er på vej efter morgenbrød

• 
Er en holdspiller, der både kan tage ansvar og have det sjovt imens

HOS THE MOOSE FÅR DU...

• 
Et deltidsjob, hvor to vagter sjældent ligner hinanden

• 
Et stærkt fællesskab med gode kollegaer og masser af sociale arrangementer

• 
Grundig oplæring – erfaring er fedt, men personlighed og attitude betyder mere

• 
Fleksible vagter, der kan passes ind ved siden af studie eller andet arbejde

• 
Personalerabat på vores barer i Indre København

• 
En arbejdsplads midt i Københavns natteliv, hvor der altid sker et eller andet

The Moose har været en del af det københavnske natteliv i mange år – og vi er langt fra færdige.

Vi bygger videre på alt det, der gør The Moose til The Moose: stemningen, gæsterne, de lange nætter og menneskerne bag baren.

Og nu mangler vi flere gode mennesker på holdet.

Så hvis et kontorjob lyder lidt kedeligere end en fyldt bar kl. 06.00, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en kort ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv – og hvorfor du kunne se dig selv bag baren på The Moose.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

CAN YOU STILL SMILE AT 5:30 AM?

Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for at The Moose.

The Moose isn’t just another bar. It’s one of Copenhagen’s most iconic late-night pubs – a place where regulars, tourists, off-duty bartenders and people who simply aren’t ready to call it a night all end up under the same roof.

Expect busy nights, cold beers, long shifts and plenty of stories that are probably better left at The Moose.

Right now, we’re giving the bar a fresh boost, and we’re looking for new bartenders to join the team.

You don’t need to know how to juggle bottles or have five years of bartending experience. We’ll teach you what you need to know.

What matters more to us is that you show up with good energy, enjoy talking to all kinds of people and want to create the kind of atmosphere that makes guests stay for “just one more”.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO...

• 
Is 18 or older

• 
Brings good energy and a positive attitude to work

• 
Can chat with both the regular in the corner and the group of tourists on their first night in Copenhagen

• 
Enjoys working when the bar is packed, the music is playing and things move fast

• 
Can keep their cool when 15 people suddenly want to order at the same time

• 
Is ready for night shifts – including the ones that end when the rest of Copenhagen is heading out for breakfast

• 
Is a team player who can take responsibility without taking themselves too seriously

AT THE MOOSE, YOU’LL GET...

• 
A part-time job where no two shifts are quite the same

• 
A strong team with great colleagues and plenty of social events

• 
Proper training – experience is great, but personality and attitude matter more

• 
Flexible shifts that work alongside studies or another job

• 
Staff discounts at our bars in central Copenhagen

• 
A workplace right in the middle of Copenhagen nightlife, where something is always happening

The Moose has been part of Copenhagen’s nightlife for many years – and we’re nowhere near finished.

We’re building on everything that makes The Moose what it is: the atmosphere, the guests, the long nights and, most importantly, the people behind the bar.

And now we need a few more great people to join us.

So if an office job sounds slightly less exciting than a packed bar at 6:00 AM, we’d love to hear from you.

Send us a short application telling us a little about yourself – and why you could see yourself behind the bar at The Moose.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description: EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.The RoleAs Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.Your responsibilities will include:    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.    Working in close cooperations with order management team     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.Is this you?To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.Do you want to know more?I In this process EYKON is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Stina Koskijev at +46735588921, or stina.koskijev@levelrecruitment.se. Please note, no applications are allowed on email. Please highlight your key skills and industry experience.We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
jobs.description: Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.About the roleAs Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.Your main responsibilities:    Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting    Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP    Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews    Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting    Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders    Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities    Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes    Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analysesWho are we looking for?To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.We are looking for someone who has:• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spokenAs a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.What Schneider Electric offersAt Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. You will be part of a professional and forward-looking finance organization where you are encouraged to grow, challenge existing ways of working and develop your career over time.This is a role where your expertise truly matters – and where you can make a real impact.Learn more at www.se.comApplicationIn this recruitment, Schneider Electric cooperates with Mpya Finance. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Our client in Namur, Belgium is looking for a Business Intelligence Specialist / BI Analyst Developer with strong experience in Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS and Power BI.
 

You will maintain and enhance existing Business Intelligence solutions while developing new reporting, data integration and analytics capabilities. Working within an established BI team, you will contribute to ETL development, data modelling, OLAP solutions, dashboards and decision-support systems, supporting business reporting and monitoring requirements.
 

Location and set-up: Namur, Belgium. Hybrid: 50% remote and 50% on-site. Contract (contractor). Fluent French and English required. European candidates are welcome to apply, but need to relocate to Namur. Applicants must have the right to work in Belgium, as a work permit is not provided.
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 
 

• Analyse business requirements and design, develop and maintain Business Intelligence solutions that meet functional and technical specifications. 

• Develop reporting solutions, interactive dashboards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) using data from operational databases. 

• Design, develop and maintain ETL processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), ensuring reliable data extraction, transformation and loading. 

• Develop and maintain OLAP and multidimensional data solutions using SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS). 

• Create and maintain reports and visualisations using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Power BI. 

• Design and optimise data models, including Star Schema and Snowflake Schema, and contribute to data architecture and modelling standards. 

• Produce technical analyses, data models, documentation and user guides while supporting knowledge transfer, training and end-user assistance. 

• Collaborate with the BI team to improve existing solutions, data integration processes and application architecture.  

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree. 

• 3+ years of professional experience in each of the following areas: BI data modelling (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema); ETL development (Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, SSIS); OLAP (Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services, SSAS); reporting and visualisation (SQL Server Reporting Services, SSRS, and Power BI); databases (SQL Server 2019 or later and multidimensional databases). 

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server database structures, data integration and reporting architectures. 

• Experience analysing functional and non-functional requirements and translating them into effective BI solutions. 

• Ability to interpret database schemas, develop technical documentation and support BI users. 

• Understanding of data modelling, semantic representation and data quality principles. 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a BI team. 

• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.  

Nice to have: experience with Microsoft Business Intelligence Suite 2019 or equivalent; familiarity with JIRA; knowledge of reporting and decision-support solutions within the public sector or agricultural policy domain.
 

Key technologies and skills: Business Intelligence, Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server 2019, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Power BI, ETL, OLAP, Data Modelling, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Multidimensional Databases, Reporting, Data Warehousing.
